title: Free-plan user needs 800 notes as PDFs
notes: Two constraints the customer does not know about: PDF export needs Pro or Team, and one export holds at most 500 notes.
carry: PDF export is available on Pro and Team plans only.
Each export can include up to 500 notes; larger libraries are exported in several batches.

traps.description: Says PDF export needs a Pro or Team plan.
Mentions the 500-note limit per export, since 800 notes need two batches.

review: Does the reply tell the customer what they can do on the free plan right now (Markdown or HTML)?
Does it avoid implying that PDF export works on the free plan?
